name: Create a segment
description: Create a saved, dynamic segment of contacts from a filter. Use when the goal is a reusable audience defined by rules (subscription status, attributes, list membership) rather than a fixed list. The public API cannot do this.

fe_query.description: Filter tree. An 'or' list of groups; each group has an 'and' list of conditions. A condition is {contact: {field, dataType, operator, value: [..]}, isValidated: true}. Valid fields and data types come from segments.list_filterable_fields.

execution.auth: Cookie session of the logged-in app.brevo.com user, sent with the request (fetch credentials: include). No API key. Replayed from inside the app page only; behavior from outside a browser (CSRF, CORS, session expiry) was not tested.

verification.notes: Executed through the UI with request capture. Created the segment 'Catalogo teste assinantes' (id 1).

side_effects: Creates a segment; the count is computed asynchronously (count_metadata.status in_progress).
preconditions: A folder exists (the default 'My segments' folder always does).
